svg.aria-label: Life of each op on stream 1, rank 0, iteration 1. The multiply's two ops run first and finish by 0.97 ms. allreduce_run returns at 1.27 ms, after LaunchAll has pushed seven collective ops; they run back to back on the COMPUTE queue until 2.72 ms. y + 1 is pushed behind them. Op 114, the first op of y + 1, blocks the scheduler thread on 8 compute fences from 2.58 to 2.70 ms. The graph then ping-pongs between DMAI and COMPUTE and synchronize() returns at 4.17 ms.
